name: Electrolyte Apple drink
ingredients_raw: Purified water, Sugars (Sucrose, Glucose), Apple Juice (reconstituted) 10%, Coconut water concentrate, Added Flavours (Natural, Nature - Identical & artificial flavouring substances [Apple]), Sodium citrate, Acidity regulator (INS 330), Potassium chloride, Sodium chloride, Magnesium sulphate, Calcium lactate, Vitamin C (Ascorbic acid), Zinc sulphate, Sodium selenate.
